name: Attune Earth 1
description: Turns your magic to Earth.  Every elemental spell becomes its earth counter-part, and starts on a 5s cooldown.  5 stages based on how long you hold it (0s, 45s, 105s, 210s, 360s), raising your spell damage by 5% to 30%, flat spell damage from 40 to 400.  Attuning again is free, and ends when you die.

name: Elemental Recharge
description: Draws mana from every burn, splash, crit and beag suain within 12 tiles (includes foes, allies and yourself).  One affliction restores 15% of your max mana, and each consecutive restores less (up to a full bar at 25).  A target with 3 afflictions will count all 3.

name: Elemental Strike 1
description: Takes the element of your necklace to assail a target up to 5 tiles away (scales with INT).
